observations.why: Requiring a signed manifest before shipping appeals to security/stability (conservation) and quality-of-craft control (competence).

evidence.quote: that is the whole reason for the gate

observations.why: Citing past failures as the justification for a gate appeals to security and preventing recurrence — conservation.
The gate specification frames a mandatory security control — conservation of safety, competence of process.
Extending the gate's scope to both environments appeals to comprehensive security coverage — conservation.
Naming an owner asserts self-origination and accountability for the gate — autonomy.
